capabilities: Keep clicked nodes and connections highlighted until Escape
Select multiple nodes with Ctrl/Cmd-click and show shared connections
Open selected notes in tabs beside a pinned graph
Colour connection lines by the node at the other end
Glide the camera to centre the selected node
extras: Works with the graph view's internal code because Obsidian offers no official graph API, so Obsidian updates could break features until the plugin is updated; it fails safely and disabling restores normal behaviour. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes a Copy diagnostics command for troubleshooting.
intentEvidence: Make Obsidian's graph view easier to explore.
problem: Obsidian's graph highlight disappears as soon as the mouse moves, so exploring connections and comparing several nodes is hard.
summary: Graph view enhancement that keeps clicked nodes and their connections highlighted, opens selected notes beside the graph, and colours links by node.
